blocking_counterexample.title: Empirical refusal capture accepts arbitrary canonical owner families and relabels constructor refusal as empirical-query refusal
construction: Supply a genuine CanonicalSemanticObject from a different public family, or a caller-defined CanonicalSemanticObject subclass.
Provide a semantic override while the copied body retains its original object_id/content_hash.
The supplied object's constructor raises Pre553IntegrityError.
The capture catches that refusal and emits refusal_kind=EMPIRICAL_INTEGRITY_REFUSAL.
The witness is labeled as execute_empirical_query even though that owner did not execute/refuse.
blocking_counterexample.fixture_confirmation: integrity_failure_fixture itself names the actual refusing owner as the CanonicalSemanticObject constructor, while the final projection asserts the empirical-query owner label.
blocking_counterexample.impact: Trusted AT14 INTEGRITY_FAILURE provenance can be minted from the wrong competent family / caller-shaped subclass under a false owner identity.
blocking_counterexample.required_correction: Bind exact empirical owner/family and governed object provenance, or truthfully classify the actual canonical constructor owner if governing AT14 law permits it; reject broad CanonicalSemanticObject/subclass inputs.

accepted_findings: Manual bare Pre553IntegrityError no longer mints trusted state.
Manual bare Pre553AuthorityError no longer mints trusted state.
Projection factories no longer accept caller producer_ref/supporting_refs/reason.
Discovery refusal capture invokes real execute_exact_bounded_discovery.
Owner acceptance does not mint refusal.
Refusal kinds keep INTEGRITY_FAILURE distinct from BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY.
AT16 54/6 positive consumer witness remains accepted.
token_note: The review does not rely on importing the module-private _TRUST_TOKEN; the owner-family counterexample is independently sufficient.
